name: Almond
overview: The almond is highlighted in Scripture both as a valued fruit and as a significant symbolic element in the tabernacle's design. It appears among the best fruits given as gifts, symbolizing blessing and provision (Genesis 43:11), and its form inspired the design of the candlestick’s bowls, knops, and flowers, reflecting God's detailed instructions for worship (Exodus 25:33-34; 37:19-20). The almond also carries figurative meaning and is connected to the Levitical city of refuge called Alemeth, underscoring its multifaceted role in God's covenant community.
